## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contract-level change.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] Python checks pass, when applicable
- [ ] TypeScript checks pass, when applicable
- [ ] Accessibility behavior reviewed, when applicable

## Public-content checklist

- [ ] Examples use synthetic data and generic branding
- [ ] No real account, organization, or individual names are included
- [ ] No internal URLs, local-machine paths, email content, or screenshots are included
- [ ] No tenant IDs, subscription IDs, resource names, tokens, or credentials are included
- [ ] Links point only to public documentation or repository content
- [ ] Preview APIs and product limitations are identified where relevant

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Tokens and provider credentials remain server-side
- [ ] Logs exclude prompts, retrieved content, identifiers, and secrets by default
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary and scoped
